Folks, let’s be entirely real about the systemic oppression and state-backed intimidation targeting our most vulnerable communities right here in Phoenix. As FOX 10's Danielle Miller reported, city leaders finally had to take steps to keep an eye on federal immigration enforcement, approving a plan on Wednesday night that puts new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property. 

For too long, local institutions have been entirely complicit by allowing federal agencies to use municipal resources to target our neighbors. This oversight exposes the urgent need for deep structural reform to dismantle these draconian immigration policies and ensure our cities are truly safe, protected sanctuaries for everyone.
